note: Three closed dimensions replacing free-text personas. JOB names a moment (circumstance + struggle), never a person. MECHANISM is the belief lever the ad pulls. CASTING is who is on screen, demoted to a readout. Derived by clustering 639 hand-read ads.

jobs.name: I have a symptom I can't say out loud
jobs.def: A private, embarrassing or socially costly body problem the buyer has never named to anyone.

jobs.name: I followed the rules and it got worse
jobs.def: Has done what they were told, seen it fail, and now distrusts the advice itself.
jobs.match: tried everything|given up|nearly quit|got worse|ran out of options|expects failure|let down|hopeless|doing everything right|resign|disillusion|stopped working|sceptic|skeptic|suspicious|distrust|doubt|been burned|prior|assumes.*(bad|won't|will not)|refuses|unwilling|objection|convinced otherwise

jobs.name: My body changed and nobody warned me
jobs.def: A sudden, unrequested change in shape, hair, skin or capacity read as betrayal rather than ageing.

jobs.name: There is one hour of the day I lose
jobs.def: A recurring, clock-anchored failure point: the crash, the craving, the empty evening, the rushed morning.

jobs.name: I'm on a drug or protocol and it left a gap
jobs.def: Already taking something (GLP-1, TRT, stimulants) and shopping for what it broke or what it left unmet.

jobs.name: I'm restocking something I already use
jobs.def: Converted. The decision is quantity, price per unit or format, not whether.

jobs.name: I've decided on the brand, now which one
jobs.def: Sold on the category and paralysed between flavours, shades, firmnesses or colourways.

jobs.name: I'm buying this for someone else
jobs.def: Purchase decided by a third party's needs or reaction: a child, a partner, a pet, a gift recipient, a client.

jobs.name: An event has forced this purchase
jobs.def: A move, a trip, a holiday, a date, a season with a date on it.

jobs.name: I've never bought this category before
jobs.def: Cold. The offer, not the product, is doing the persuading.
jobs.match: first (order|time|box)|trial|toe-dip|sampler|never bought|new to|starter|try before|discovery set|cold|has not|never|unfamiliar|entry point|low commitment|audition|blind|risk of being first|prospect not a customer

jobs.name: I'm trying to quit something I already buy
jobs.def: Defecting from an existing habit, brand, or spend: soda, creamer, the clinic, the drugstore, the convenience store.

jobs.name: My routine is something I perform
jobs.def: Buys what will survive being filmed or displayed; the product is a prop in a life being shown.

jobs.name: I can't judge this myself, so tell me who did
jobs.def: Lacks the expertise or patience to evaluate the product and outsources the decision to a credential, a crowd or a famous name.

jobs.name: I need to know what's actually in it
jobs.def: Reads the label before the claim. Screening for what has been removed, hidden or misnamed.

jobs.name: I assume this will taste or feel bad
jobs.def: Carries a prior that the healthy or functional version is punishment, and that prior is the only obstacle.

jobs.name: I already run a system and I'm upgrading it
jobs.def: Self-quantifier or committed user tuning an existing regimen rather than starting one.

jobs.name: I want to be seen as someone who owns this
jobs.def: A social job: the purchase is a membership signal. Doctrine-legitimate as a social lane, never judged on evergreen DR.

jobs.name: I'm waiting for the price to be right
jobs.def: Wants the product, refuses the price, and is timing the purchase to a discount, a bundle or a free add-on.

mechanisms.name: Blame relocated to biology
mechanisms.def: Moves the cause from the buyer's behaviour to a named internal mechanism.

mechanisms.name: Authority borrowed from outside
mechanisms.def: A credential the advertiser does not own: a celebrity, a clinician, an award, a masthead, a team.

mechanisms.name: Peer proof over brand claim
mechanisms.def: Another buyer, ideally unrehearsed, does the arguing.

mechanisms.name: Screened on what is absent
mechanisms.def: Sold on what has been removed: seed oils, polyester, microplastics, sugar, chemicals.

mechanisms.name: Risk removed before payment
mechanisms.def: Don't pay yet. Trials, guarantees, zero-due-today, money back.

mechanisms.name: Value computed as arithmetic
mechanisms.def: The buyer does maths: per-unit price, free-gift dollar value, strike-through, bundles.
mechanisms.match: arithmetic|per-unit|unit price|maths|free gift|dollar value|percentage|cost per|strike|bundle|discount|% off|saving

mechanisms.name: Scarcity, or the discount as a mistake
mechanisms.def: Sold out, back in stock, limited drop, we made too much, apologies to last week's buyers.
mechanisms.match: sold out|back in stock|limited|scarcit|last chance|drop|restock|mistake|apolog|overstock|too much|ends toni

mechanisms.name: A demonstration you couldn't run yourself
mechanisms.def: A physical test, stunt or macro shot that proves a property.

mechanisms.name: Says the embarrassing thing plainly
mechanisms.def: Uses the blunt word for the private problem, and that bluntness is the hook.

mechanisms.name: A number to hold onto
mechanisms.def: A specific figure the buyer can repeat: a percentage, a multiple, a timeline, a lab value.

mechanisms.name: Bought to be seen owning it
mechanisms.def: The purchase signals taste, tribe or status; how it looks to others is the benefit.

mechanisms.name: Verified by a shelf you already walk past
mechanisms.def: Physical availability retires the is-this-a-scam question.

mechanisms.name: Sold a ritual, not a product
mechanisms.def: Buys a sequence or a moment; the routine is the thing being purchased.

mechanisms.name: Shown how and where it was made
mechanisms.def: Process, provenance and raw materials do the persuading.

casting.name: Peer to camera
casting.match: peer|woman talking|face-to-camera|her own kitchen|straight to camera|informal|unstyled|creator|talking head
